title: Soul Snack # 38: Guided Meditation (Partnership Between Equals)
excerpt: Join Gary LIVE every month as he shares his wisdom and answers your questions live.
bodyHtml:
Join Gary LIVE every month as he shares his wisdom and answers your questions live. REGISTER HERE for An Evening with Gary Zukav.

In this Soul Snack, Gary Zukav offers a powerful guided meditation centered on the experience of equality – soul-to-soul connection that transcends fear and invites you to create authentic power.

As he gently guides listeners into stillness, Gary explores how spiritual partnership is rooted not in hierarchy, but in mutual support for spiritual growth.

The Soul Snack dives deeper into the essence of equality – not as a surface-level dynamic, but as a lived experience made possible through aligning personality with the soul.

He explains that superiority and inferiority are rooted in fear, and only through cultivating love – gratitude, patience, and compassion – can we experience true equality.

Listeners are encouraged to observe how fear-based feelings of inferiority or superiority block authentic connection, and how the path to spiritual partnership begins by challenging those parts of ourselves.

This meditation supports you in doing just that – gently, consciously, and with compassion.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

(00:30) – A grounding introduction to the meditation and reminder to listen only when in a safe, undistracted environment
(01:15) – Beginning the meditation: breathwork, relaxation, and releasing tension into the earth
(02:50) – The core teaching: equality is a soul-to-soul experience rooted in authentic power
(04:10) – Understanding superiority and inferiority as expressions of fear
(05:00) – How creating authentic power transforms us and our relationships
(06:00) – Returning to presence: opening your eyes and carrying the insight forward

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge:
Reflect on a moment when you felt superior or inferior to someone. What sensations were present in your energy processing centers? What thoughts were this frightened part of your personality having? Can you identify a frightened part of your personality that was active? Take time to sit in stillness and reconnect with the loving parts of yourself – gratitude, caring, appreciation, patience, and compassion. In this space, can you feel the soul-to-soul equality that Gary describes? Let this meditation be your practice ground for creating authentic power.
